subject: Leadership
content: Fairness means treating everyone equally and following the same rules for everyone. A fair leader does not pick favorites. They listen to all sides before deciding. They share things equally. They take turns. Being fair means even when you don't like a rule, you follow it. If you see someone being treated unfairly, speak up kindly. Say 'That doesn't seem fair. Can we find a better way?' Fairness builds trust and respect. People trust leaders who are fair. Practice fairness every day.
summary: Fairness means treating everyone equally. Don't pick favorites. Listen to all sides. Share equally. Take turns. Fair leaders earn trust.
nigerian_examples: Taking turns on the playground slide
Listening to both sides when friends argue

quiz_questions.question: What does fairness mean?
quiz_questions.explanation: Fairness means applying the same rules to everyone.

quiz_questions.question: What should a fair leader do when friends argue?
quiz_questions.explanation: Hearing everyone's side helps you make a fair decision.

quiz_questions.question: What is an example of being fair?
options: Giving more to your best friend
quiz_questions.explanation: Taking turns ensures everyone gets a chance.

quiz_questions.question: Why is fairness important for leaders?
quiz_questions.explanation: People trust and respect leaders who treat everyone fairly.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: It is fair to change rules to help your friend win.
quiz_questions.explanation: Fairness means everyone follows the same rules.

subject: Leadership
content: Rules tell us how to behave to keep everyone safe and happy. Good leaders follow rules and help others follow them too. Rules at school: walk quietly in the hallway, raise your hand to speak, share materials. Rules at home: do your chores, speak respectfully, finish homework. Rules in games: take turns, no cheating, play fairly. When you follow rules, you show respect for the people who made them and the people around you. Leaders don't break rules. They set an example by following them.
summary: Rules keep everyone safe and happy. Good leaders follow rules and help others follow them. Following rules shows respect.
nigerian_examples: Following road safety rules when crossing streets
Obeying home rules about screen time

quiz_questions.correct_answer: Follow rules and help others follow them
quiz_questions.explanation: Leaders set a good example and help others do right.

quiz_questions.question: What is a rule at school?
quiz_questions.explanation: Raising your hand gives everyone a chance to speak.

quiz_questions.question: What happens when everyone follows rules?
options: Everyone is safe and things run smoothly
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Everyone is safe and things run smoothly
quiz_questions.explanation: Rules help create order so everyone can learn and play.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Leaders can break rules because they are special.
quiz_questions.explanation: Good leaders follow rules and show rules apply to everyone.

subject: Leadership
content: Leading activities means guiding a group through a game, project, or task. A good activity leader plans ahead, explains instructions clearly, makes sure everyone gets a turn, and keeps everyone safe. Before starting, say what you will do and what rules to follow. During the activity, watch to see if everyone understands and is included. After, thank everyone for participating. You can lead games like football or board games. You can lead group work or cleaning time. Leading activities helps you practice speaking and helping others.
summary: Leading activities: plan ahead, explain clearly, include everyone, keep safe. Thank participants. Lead games, group work, or cleaning.
learning_objectives: Learn how to lead group activities
nigerian_examples: Leading a football game during break time
Organizing a group to clean the classroom
Leading a song during school assembly

quiz_questions.question: What should a good activity leader do before starting?
options: Only tell one person the rules
quiz_questions.explanation: Clear instructions help everyone know what to do.

quiz_questions.question: What should a leader do during the activity?
options: Make sure everyone is included and safe
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Make sure everyone is included and safe
quiz_questions.explanation: Good leaders ensure everyone participates and no one gets hurt.

quiz_questions.question: What should a leader say at the end of an activity?
quiz_questions.explanation: Thanking participants shows appreciation and encourages them to join again.

quiz_questions.question: What can you lead as a Grade 2 student?
quiz_questions.explanation: You can lead many activities at school and home.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: A leader should only include their best friends in activities.
quiz_questions.explanation: Good leaders include everyone, not just their closest friends.
